categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Jujie Microfiber Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of superfine composite microfiber fabrics and finished products. Its main product categories include superfine microfiber finished products, superfine microfiber imitation leather fabrics, superfine microfiber functional fabrics, and superfine microfiber dust-free clean products. The company also provides dyeing and finishing processing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced superfine composite fiber technology, including proprietary opening fiber processes that achieve over 99% fiber separation rate, color fastness control technology, and unique finishing and raising processes to produce high-quality microfiber fabrics. It has a complete production chain from spinning, weaving, dyeing, finishing to finished product processing, supported by 27 invention patents and 28 utility model patents. The company emphasizes green and clean production techniques and is developing new environmentally friendly dyeing and electronic fabric technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are internationally renowned brands, with Decathlon being the largest client accounting for over 50% of sales. The company also supplies to global brands such as H&M and major automotive and electronics manufacturers. Its products serve markets including sportswear, home textiles, automotive interiors, electronics, and precision manufacturing sectors requiring dust-free cleaning materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, headquartered in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, with sales both domestically and internationally. Overseas sales account for approximately 53% of revenue, with significant exports to the US, EU, ASEAN, and other global markets. It has established marketing offices in Shanghai and Shenzhen and planned but canceled expansion in Milan, Italy.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jujie Microfiber operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the textile supply chain, focusing on the production of superfine microfiber fabrics and finished products. It controls the entire production process from raw material processing to finished goods and supplies directly to brand customers, positioning itself as a key supplier in the microfiber textile industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous improvement in quality management, R&D innovation, and alignment with international standards. It focuses on developing high-value-added products, expanding applications in automotive and electronic fabrics, and advancing intelligent manufacturing. R&D efforts include environmentally friendly dyeing technologies, electronic fabric development, and enhancing product durability and color stability. Collaboration with universities and research institutes supports its innovation pipeline.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of microfiber fabrics and finished products under the company's own brands. The company adopts a direct sales model, serving large international brand customers with customized products. It also earns income from dyeing and finishing processing services and investments in related textile enterprises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jujie Microfiber is one of the earliest and leading domestic companies specializing in superfine composite microfiber materials in China. It holds a strong competitive position with advanced technology and quality comparable or superior to traditional producers in Japan and South Korea. The domestic textile industry is fragmented with many small and medium enterprises, but Jujie stands out due to its comprehensive production chain, patented technologies, and stable relationships with global brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 599.5 million, a 12.46% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 64.45 million, down 13.42%. Despite revenue decline, the company increased net profit excluding non-recurring items by 56.43%. Total assets were about RMB 1.02 billion with stable asset base and a net asset value of RMB 876.7 million. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues investing in R&D and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jujie Microfiber emphasizes its industry-leading superfine composite fiber technology, delivering products with superior softness, high absorption, durability, breathability, and environmental friendliness. Its proprietary opening fiber and finishing processes yield microfiber fabrics with excellent color fastness and imitation leather quality that rival or surpass international competitors. The company’s products cater to high-end markets requiring advanced functional textiles, supported by strong R&D capabilities and long-term partnerships with global brands.
